(VI)--a king of the Bharata dynasty; had for his son कामदेव, or God of Love. M. 4. १९.
(VII)--a son of सोमशर्म, an अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. २१६.

(IX)--a son of गार्ग्य. वा. ९२. ७३.

(I)--a branch of the भार्गवस्. Br. III. 1. १००.

(I)--a son of देवमीढ and मारिषा; married Apsaras मिश्रकेशि; father of वृक and other sons. भा. IX. २४. २९ and ४३.

--the son of Bhalandana and father of प्राम्शु;
1: भा. IX. 2. २३-24.

(I)--a son of Dhruva. भा. III. ११. १४; IV. १०. 1. [page३-144+ २६]
(II)--a son of ब्रह्मी, was elected to Dhru- va's throne as Utkala was engaged in penance and prayer; his wife was स्वर्वीथी, who bore him six sons. भा. IV. १३. ११-12.
(V)--a sage by तपस्; a कश्यप and Brahma- वादिन्; sage of the Vaivasvata epoch and a ऋषिक. Br. II. ३२. १०१-12; ३८. २९; M. १४५. ९५; वा. ५९. ९२.
(VII)--not to inter-marry with the members of कश्यप and वसिष्ठ gotras. M. १९९. १०.
--a गोत्रकार son of कश्यप; father of Nidhruva and Rebhya (Raibhya-वा। प्।); a ब्रह्मवादिन्. Br. III. 8. २९-30; M. १४५. १०६; वा. ६४. २८; ७०. २५.
--five-year cycle. भा. III. ११. १४-15.
--a son of Urukriya (उरुक्षय-वि। प्।) and father of Prativyoma. भा. IX. १२. १०; Vi. IV. २२. 3. [page३-145+ २५]
--a son of क्षय. वा. ९९. २८१.
--a son of Senajit. Vi. IV. १९. ३६.
(I)--the राक्षस presiding over the month of Tapas; with the शरत् Sun. भा. XII. ११. ३९; Br. II. २३. १५; वा. ५२. १५; Vi. II. १०. ११.
(II)--a son of यातुधान, and father of Virodha who was death to the people. Br. III. 7. ८९ and ९६.
(III)--a son of शूर. Br. III. ७१. १३८; वा. ९६. १३६.
(V)--one of the seven seers of the स्वारोचिष epoch. Vi. III. 1. ११.
--a son of मृग elephant. Br. III. 7. ३३२.
--of कौशिक gotra. Br. III. ६६. ७०.
--a son of Satajit. Br. III. ७१. ५५.
--(Mt.) a hill in India. Br. II. १६. २१.
--a Janapada of the भद्रा country. वा. ४३. २०.
--a class of gods performing श्राद्ध. Br. III. १०. ११०; वा. ७३. ६२.

--There are seven वातस्कन्धस् each with a Marut गण of seven. In the first the seven are शक्र- jyoti, Satya, Satyajyoti, Citrajyoti, ज्योतिष्मान्, Sutapas and Caitya; ऋतजित्, Satyajit, सुषेण, Senajit, Sutamitra, Amitra and Suramitra are in the second; in the third धातु, Dhanada, Ugra, भीम, वरुण, अभियुक्ताक्षिक and साह्वय; in the fourth, the names of the गण are omitted in the text; in the fifth ईदृक्, अन्यादृक्, ससरिद्द्रुमवृक्षकस्, Mita and Samita; in the sixth, ईदृक् Purus2a, नान्यादृक्, Sama- cetana, Sammita, समवृत्ति, and Pratiharta; in the seventh, the names not clear. Br. III. 5. ७८-80, ९०-96. [page३-187+ २९]

--Paths of वायु through which the Marut गणस् travel. Seven of them are said to have their stations in पृथ्वी (earth), भास्कर (sun), Soma (moon) Constellation group, Planets, सप्तऋषिमण्डल and Dhruva, with their respective chiefs: आवह, Pravaha, Udvaha, Samvaha, Vivaha, Anuvaha and Parivaha. Br. III. 5. ७८-80; वा. ६७. ११०-12.
